name: ImageZoom
intent: A thumbnail that opens the full image in a large modal on click — a maximize hint appears on hover. Use for plans, blueprints, screenshots, or any image worth inspecting at full size.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: title
props.description: Title shown in the enlarge dialog header. Defaults to `alt`.

props.name: dialogMaxWidth
props.description: Max width of the dialog. Defaults to `1400px`.

usage: Use ImageZoom to present visual information or status indicators to users. This component helps convey information quickly through visual representation.

ImageZoom is effective for showing user identity, status, categories, or labels. Keep usage consistent throughout your application to help users quickly recognize and understand the information being displayed.
